_comment: The Laravel Reverb column's dependencies, pinned so a newer release is a deliberate
bump and not a surprise in a number. Installed into vendor/ under this directory by
run-bench.sh, never globally: this harness is one command and it must not change the
machine it runs on beyond its own directory.
laravel/framework rather than the laravel/laravel skeleton: this column has no
models, no views, no router beyond what Reverb mounts, and a skeleton would commit
forty files none of which the measurement reads. ratchet/pawl is the subscriber side,
because Reverb speaks the Pusher protocol and PHP has no built-in WebSocket client.
name: synqt/bench-php
description: The Laravel Reverb column of the SynQt framework comparison
